info.name: Legal Metrology ML Service
info.description:
Direct calls to the FastAPI ML service (default port 7860).

Start it first:
  cd ml-service
  .venv\Scripts\activate
  uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 7860

Then: run Health, then Analyze (attach a JPEG/PNG under the `images` form field).
Sample label images are in ml-service/data/raw_images/.

request.description: Returns the current rule matrix (rules_config.json) — the mandatory declarations, format regexes, font-size tables and severities the engine checks against.

formdata.description: One or more JPEG/PNG photos of the product's principal display panel. Keep the barcode in frame for print-size calibration.
Optional. Echoed back in the response as product_id; a UUID is generated if omitted.
